name: Cobalt Grid
description: A two-colour system in the manner of a Japanese trend report: warm cream paper with electric cobalt as the only ink, and a 42px graph-paper grid over the whole page. Newsreader serif headings (CJK falls back to Noto Serif TC or PMingLiU), Hanken Grotesk body text, DM Mono furniture. The signature decoration is a pixel-stair scan column on the right and two 1.5px hairlines top and bottom; no shadows, no rounded corners, no second colour. Ported from beautiful-html-templates’ cobalt-grid.

ink.use: all text, lines and decoration: the one ink of the whole system

muted.use: secondary text and italic keywords (cobalt one step lighter)

accent.use: the accent is the same as the ink; chart fills, icons, nodes

surface.use: card, table header and code block background (paper one step darker)

grid.use: graph-paper grid lines (the original’s 10% cobalt, pre-blended)

faint.use: chart tracks, inner table rules (the original’s 18% cobalt)

display.family: 'Newsreader', 'Noto Serif TC', 'Songti TC', 'PMingLiU', 'Source Han Serif TC', Georgia, serif

body.family: 'Hanken Grotesk', 'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', 'Source Han Sans TC', sans-serif
